name: acad-dimensions
description: AutoCAD parametric dimension entities: linear (rotated and aligned), angular (3-point and 2-line), radial, diametric, arc-length, ordinate, plus baseline and continued chains derived from a prior dimension. Includes dimension style (DimStyle) lookup and assignment. All write operations require the AcadMcp .NET plugin loaded inside an open AutoCAD session and run inside a single transaction with a document lock.

tools_summary.name: apply_arch_tick_style
tools_summary.description: Scan every Dimension entity on a given layer and re-assign its dimension style to the target (default ARCH-ISO). If ensureStyle=true the target style is auto-created via ensure_architectural_dimstyle first. Useful for retrofitting legacy drawings to rule 66's architectural tick convention in one call.

tools_summary.name: auto_dim_walls
tools_summary.description: Automatically build a continued dimension chain across a list of wall handles. Each wall's start/end endpoints are projected onto the baseline direction through 'origin' + 'baselineDeg'; duplicates within mergeToleranceMm are collapsed. Remaining projected points are sorted and fed to continued_chain. Walls whose endpoints cannot be resolved (non-Curve entities) are returned in skippedHandles instead of aborting. Combined with ensure_architectural_dimstyle this replaces 90%+ of manual DIMLINEAR / DIMCONT chains when dimensioning a facade.

tools_summary.name: dimension_aligned
tools_summary.description: Place an aligned dimension parallel to the segment p1->p2 at dimLinePoint.

tools_summary.name: dimension_angular_2l
tools_summary.description: Place an angular dimension between two existing line entities. The arc passes through arcPoint.

tools_summary.name: dimension_angular_3p
tools_summary.description: Place an angular dimension defined by a vertex (center) and two rays through 'first' and 'second'. The arc passes through arcPoint.

tools_summary.name: dimension_arc_length
tools_summary.description: Place an arc-length dimension on an Arc; arcPoint locates the dimension arc.

tools_summary.name: dimension_baseline_chain
tools_summary.description: Build a baseline chain of linear dimensions from a common baseline point to N subsequent points; spacing is taken from the dimstyle's DIMDLI.

tools_summary.name: dimension_continued_chain
tools_summary.description: Build a continued chain of linear dimensions: each new dimension's first extension line is the previous dimension's second extension line.

tools_summary.name: dimension_cumulative_chain
tools_summary.description: Cumulative dimension chain: N dimensions sharing a SINGLE dim line, each reporting the distance from baselinePoint to point_i (running total). Use for exterior overall/axis/opening dimension rows per rule 66 §1. Differs from baseline_chain (staggered by DIMDLI) and continued_chain (end-to-end).

tools_summary.name: dimension_diametric
tools_summary.description: Place a diametric dimension on a Circle through farPoint (the leader anchor on the far side of the curve).

tools_summary.name: dimension_linear
tools_summary.description: Place a linear (rotated) dimension between p1 and p2 with the dim line passing through dimLinePoint at the given rotation in degrees (0 = horizontal).

tools_summary.name: dimension_ordinate
tools_summary.description: Place an ordinate (X or Y datum) dimension at definingPoint with leader endpoint at leaderEnd. useXAxis=true measures the X distance from UCS origin.

tools_summary.name: dimension_overall
tools_summary.description: Place a single linear dimension spanning the overall bbox of one or more entities projected onto rotationDeg. Useful for 'outer-most' exterior dimensions (rule 66 level 1). rotationDeg 0° measures along X (horizontal), 90° along Y. Uses the bounding boxes fetched via acad.geometry2d.get_entity.

tools_summary.name: dimension_radial
tools_summary.description: Place a radial dimension on a Circle or Arc; chordPoint specifies which side of the curve the leader exits.

tools_summary.name: ensure_architectural_dimstyle
tools_summary.description: Idempotently create (or update) the ARCH-ISO dimension style used by the 3-level architectural dimension hierarchy (rule 66). Sets architectural tick arrowheads ('ArchTick'), text height scaled to plot scale, mm precision, no trailing zeros. Safe to call multiple times; returns whether the style was created, updated or left untouched.

tools_summary.name: list_dimstyles
tools_summary.description: List all dimension styles defined in the active drawing plus the current Dimstyle.

tools_summary.name: set_entity_dimstyle
tools_summary.description: Assign a dimension style to one or more existing dimension entities (by handle).
